༄༅/ /phyag mchod skor pa'i skabs su zur rgyan nye bar mkho ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag mchod skor pa'i skabs su zur rgyan nye bar mkho ba bzhugs/

na mo shākya mu na ye/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs nas mchod pa dang bskor ba'i phan yon bskor ba'i tshad bskor ba'i tshul rnams ni gzhan du rgyas par bshad zin pas der shes par bya la/ 'dir phyag dang mchod pa dang skor ba gsum gyi skabs su zur rgyan nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang phyag bya ba'i tshe sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang ngam nyung yang rung med kyang rung*/ der dkon mchog gsum po thams cad 'dus nas bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas te/ oṃ na mo mañdzu shri ye/ na maḥsu shrī ye/ na maḥ.u t+ta mashrī ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dad shugs drag pos phyag byas na phyag stong 'gyur du 'gro ba dang*/ brkyang phyag lan gsum byas na rgyal ba'i bka' thams cad bklags pa'i bsod nams 'thob par 'gyur zhes bu ston rin po che dang*/ paṇa chen rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyis bshad 7 mchod pa che chung gang 'byor bshams pa yod na dang*/ med kyang mos pa shugs drag gis mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs ton na phan yon che bar bshad pas de ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra marda ni/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+ra/ mahā bi d+yā badz+ra/ mahā bo nghi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes brjod nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te rgyal ba thams cad mchod par 'gyur ba dang*/ lan bdun nam/ gsum dang*/ lan gcig brjod na'ang rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i char chen po 'bab par rgyud dang*/ paṇa chen rin po ches kyang bshad do/ 7 /me tog 'bul pa'i tshe/ na mo bha ga wa te/ puṣ+be ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṣ+pe puṣ+pe/ puṣ+pe su puṣ+pe su puṣ+pe/ puṣ+pe a wa ka ri ni swā hā /zhes brjod cing phul na me tog bye ba re phul pa'i yon 'byung bar mdo dang paṇa chen rin po che sogs kyis bshad do//

bskor ba byed pa'i tshe/ na mo da sha di kī kā la sarba rataṇa tra yā ya/ na maḥpra dak+ṣa su pra dak+ṣa sarba pā paṃ bi sho ngha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bskor na sdig pa 'dag cing 'gyur dang phan yon che bar bshad do/ /yang skor ba'i sngags gcig ni/ na mo bha ga wa te/ rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya /a r+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dha ya/ ta d+ya thā/ oṃ rat+ne rat+ne mahā rat+na rat+na bi ji ya swā hā/ zhes pa ste phan yon ni sngar ltar ro/ 7 /gzhan dmigs brtse ma dang ma ṇi sogs dge sbyor gang la 'jug par 'dod pa de dang*/ khyad par du bde ba can dang dga' ldan du skyes bar 'dod na/ 'od dpag med dang byams pa'i gzungs ring 'don cing*/ las sgrib sbyong ba'i ched du yig brgya dang mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs brjod na legs par bshad cing*/ dkor sgrib 'dag pa'i ched du ni/ na mo bha ga wa te/ su me ru kalpa rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ kalpe kalpe ma hā kalpe/ kalpe pa ri sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod na /dkor sgrib kyi phung po 'dags par bshad la/ nad zhi ba'i don du yin na/ sangs rgyas rdo rje bla ma'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ tad+ya*/ /oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ sarba bya dhi ha na ha na/ badz+ra ha na bdag gi nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cing swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bskor na phan par bshad do/ /yang skor ba byed pa sogs kyi tshe mchod rten chen po'i grib ma 'gom mi rung bas/ 'gom dgos pa byung ni/ oṃ badz+ra be ga a kra ma hūṃ/ zhes brjod nas yid kyis grib ma'i 'og tu 'dzul bar mos te 'gro bar bya'o/ zhes pa 'di yang sngags 'chang tshe dbang rab brtan sogs rang gi sde ba'i dad ldan rnams kyis bskur pa'i ngor bshad sgrub ming can gyis bkod pa ste/ par du brko ba po ni khra 'og gi sngags 'chang skal bzang ngo*/ yi ge pa ni sna lam rnam rgyal lo/ /mad+ga laṃ/
/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/phyag mchod skor ba'i skabs su zur rgyan nye bar mkho ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 366--PAGE 365--PAGE 364-
